tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jigs byed la gtor 'bul byed tshul bzhugs/

na mo badzra bhe ra wa ye/ 'jigs byed la gtor 'bul byed tshul la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod pa las/ rgyas pa ni gzhan du shes par bya zhing*/ 'dir 'bring dang bsdus pa'i dbang du byas te 'chad pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mngon rtogs bsgoms te bzlas pa mchod bstod dang bcas pa'i thun gyi mjug lta bu'am/ de min kyang gtor ma 'bul na/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed nas yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur bar bsams te/ mchod gtor byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa skad cig gis grub par gyur pa ni/ rang gi mdun du srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang chos 'byung gi dbus su padma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gzhal yas khang grub zhi sgo bzhi pa rgyan rta babs la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa rdo rwa me ri dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du dur khrod rnams kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du re mig dgu pa gdan dang bcas pa'i dbus su dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu /phyag so bzhi zhabs bcu drug pa g.yas bskums shing g.yon pa rkyang ba yum dang bcas par gyur/ nang gi shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po yab yum/ nas byang sgor ral gri gshin rje gshed ljang khu yab yum/ shar lhor tsa rtsig dkar mo yab yum/ nub byang shar du gau ri ljang khu yab yum/ thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rang rang gi nyams yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyi'i grwa bzhir bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o/ /de las bsdu na/ dbus su dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed yab yum/ nang gi shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed yab yum/ nas byang shar du gau ri ljang khu yab yum/ phyi'i grwa bzhir sogs sbyor/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya byas te/

oṃ hrīḥṣtī nas ā karṣa ya dzaḥswā hā/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo gshin rje gshed phyag na lcags kyu dang*/ nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi'i phyogs mtshams rnams su 'khod pa ni/ shar du dbang po dmar ser nas srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs rnams dang bcas par gyur/ de nas phur 'debs kyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ hrīḥṣtīḥnas kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo gshin rje gshed phyag na phur bu nas yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur par bsam/ de las bsdu na/ 'khod pa ni zhes pa'i 'phro nyid du phur gdab kyi sngags brjod kyang rung*/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi mig gnyis su sa snying gi rang bzhin kṣiṃ kṣiṃ dkar po/ nas thugs kar thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur pa bsam pa'am/ mig gnyis su kṣiṃ sogs gang rung bya/ oṃ hrīḥha bhoḥ nas swā hā/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las nas rten dang brten par bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ hrīḥṣtīḥsogs kyis bgegs bskrad/ 'di nas rgyas 'debs kyi bar sgrub thabs ltar ram/ bsdu na/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang rang gi nas sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ sngar bzhin mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba nas hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing*/ nas phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa re res rgyas btab ste/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ de nas sngags tsam gyis mchod cing bstod pa'am/ min kyang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags nas gsol bar gyur par bsams te/ gtso bo yab yum la thun mong du sngags kyi mthar i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa bdun dang*/

'khor gyi lha rnams la sngags kyi mthar ba ling ta pra titstsha btags pa gsum gyis phul la/ oṃ hrīḥṣtīḥha sogs kyi mchod de/ sngags rnams kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags te nang mchod kyang 'bul/ gnyis med thun mong ma yin sogs sam/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos po zhes sogs kyis bstod/ de nas phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags nas gsol bar gyur par bsams la/ ya ma rā dzā tshar gcig gis byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ bhu tsa ra ṇaṃ sogs lan gsum gyis phyogs skyong 'bul te/ oṃ da sha sogs kyis phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ bcom ldan chos rje sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol te/ gshin rje gshed kyi yig brgya dang*/ ma rnyed sogs kyis bzod gsol bya/ chos rgyal la gtor 'bul mi byed na 'dir gshegs gsol dang*/ byed na 'og nas 'chad pa ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsdus pa la'ang gsum las/ dang po ni/ mchod gtor byin gyis brlabs te/ gzhung du gsal ba ltar/ mdun du skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong bco lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dkug ste/ phyogs mtshams rnams su 'khod pa skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug nas skur bzhengs pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags nas gsol bar gyur bar bsams la sngar bzhin gtso 'khor rnams 'bul te phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa bya/ phyogs skyong gi ljags brlabs te/ sngar bzhin phul nas mchod bstod bya'o/ /phyogs skyong rgyas par gsal 'debs na 'khod pa ni/ shar du dbang po dmar ser sogs sgrub thabs bzhin gsal gdab bo/

/gnyis pa ni/ gtor ma brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje'i 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥpadma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hū?ṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong bco lnga 'khor dang bcas pa bkug ste dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams rnams su 'khod pa skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug nas yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs pa'i 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgon rnams kyi ljags hūṃ nas gsol bar gyur bar bsams la sngar bzhin mchod bstod bcas bya/ phyogs skyong rgyas par byed nas da sngar bzhin bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gtor ma brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lta bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa la phyogs skyong bco lngas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa 'od gsal du bcug nas bzhengs pa'i 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ljags nas 'bul tshul sogs ni sngar bzhin no/ /'di dag kyang mkhas pa'i man ngag las 'byung zhing*/ phyogs skyong dgug gzhug gi sngags 'don mi 'don sogs las byed tshul gzhan yang yod do/ /chos rgyal la gtor ma 'bul na/ / mdun du padma dang nyi ma sogs mngon rtogs ltar ram/ bsdu na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas dam can chos kyi rgyal po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ chos kyi rgyal po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ nas gsol bar gyur bar bsams la/ oṃ kā la rū pa sogs kyis gtor ma phul nas/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ 'chi bdag ma'am/

'jam dpal bka' mnyan sogs kyis bstod la/ yig brgya brjod de/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang med na gshegs tshul ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ badzra muḥ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs shing*/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim mgron gzhan rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces bya'o/ /de nas bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgoms pa yin na/ nyer bsdu byas te/ de las langs nas bsngo smon bkra shis sogs bya'o/ /ces pa 'di yang shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis bar gyur cig /// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/'jigs byed la gtor 'bul byed tshul bzhugs/ -PAGE 288--PAGE 285--PAGE 284-
